messages.subject: problem to get Spectro...
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I do not manage anymore to get the spectro of my .wav files... Here is the error message I get :
"Erreur dans inputw(wave = wave, f = f) :
  tentative d'obtenir le slot "bits" d'un objet d'une classe élémentaire ("matrix") sans slots"
 after entering for instance:
> son<-loadSample("V4.wav")
> spectro(son,ovl=90,wl=1000,flim=c(0,7000),grid=FALSE,scale=FALSE,collevels=seq(-40,0,1))

Someone can help me to understand this error message?
Thank you
Florence
